cold_scrub.method: Natural cold project and fresh process per trial; both HEAD and candidate use the default D (suspend both background task types when dragging). No injected workload or prewarming. Backend activity recorded as observed at first press. A (allow both) was not applied in these trials.

optical_change_definition: ScreenCaptureKit display timestamps, centre 320x180 window sample, mean absolute consecutive RGB difference > 0.12 after discarding sample borders. The gaps include first input and end of gesture.

trace_buffer.retention: Cleared at the start of each play or gesture, and after close and before reopen
trace_buffer.estimate_method: List object plus private numerical objects per representative [t, shared gl-blit tag, generation, frame] row; exact stored row count is peak. Actual tags/payloads vary.

stability.kind: 4K H.264 with linked audio and 33-cube LUT, ordinary play and alternating reverse/forward 20 ms mouse drags on Color

measurement_info.rss: psutil process RSS and OS threads every 2 seconds in a separate process
measurement_info.cache: Sum of reported Color master and proxy decoded cache bytes and Edit Program frame-cache bytes; absent caches have null component values
measurement_info.decoder: Weakly observed FFmpeg open master/seek AVContainers and application-owned VtSession decompression handles. AVFoundation/driver total sessions and per-process GPU memory unavailable.
measurement_info.timeline: 25 fps, source offset 25, single linked A/V, Color original clip, one 33-cube LUT

external_sampling.note: Resource soak with distinct frame and exact-target checks. Exclude this loop from speed/latency inference.

comparison_semantics.rss: OS resident size (not total allocations, GPU usage or private footprint), independent 2s sampling
comparison_semantics.cold_first_minute_vs_warm_last: Active window sampled from first Color control ready through the end of the final two-way gesture
comparison_semantics.process_exit: Zero process resources after exit does not establish all resources were released by project close

supplemental_close_reopen.reason: Coarse Qt timer reopened at 15.43 s in the 603.436 s trial. Independently confirm at least 18 s after project close using a monotonic deadline.

darwin_memory_samples.units: MiB. Early vmmap decimal displays in KiB/MiB/GiB rounded to the precision printed; later measurements use exact Mach page bytes. Kernel VM tag counters reflect resident pages in mappings and can double-count shared mappings. The early vmmap dirty field excludes clean/reusable bytes differently from kernel pri_pages_dirtied, so only compare the resident rows for early versus late. Do not sum categories into RSS or identify the allocating library from a tag alone.
